t: Energer ENB1355MIX electric paddle mixer delivers smooth, controlled mixing of paint, mortar and other construction materials. The reliable corded power tool is ideal for plasterers and builders working on busy job sites. Features a powerful 1200W motor combined with a durable aluminium alloy gearbox, to ensure reliable performance under heavy loads. Variable speed control allows adjustment of the mixing speed for different tasks, and soft-start function helps prevent splashing by allowing gradual acceleration. Soft-grip handles reduce vibration to minimise user fatigue during extended operation. Supplied with a mixing paddle but without a carry case.
b: Cut-Off Protection Enhances User Safety & Control
M14 Spindle Thread Fits Standard Mixing Paddles
